name: Will
why: Completed couch to 5k -- and my friends were there to cheer me on at the beginning, middle, and end of the race.

turns.question: What event or accomplishment would you like to remember? Give me the short version of what happened.
turns.answer: COuch to 5k after thinking I would not have run before. My friends were there to support me and I had a greaet time, and proved I could do something. Now I want to do more!

turns.question: What made this matter to you personally? What would help someone understand why you wanted to do it?
turns.answer: I had never considered myself a runner and now I can.

turns.question: What was it about trying this for the first time that mattered to you?
What should we know about the event itself: the setting, distance, route, or kind of challenge?
turns.answer: This event was in Dallas and went downtown, which is also near where I worked at the time. It was fun to see the urban setting trasnformed into a community event with people from all over and that typically busy streets were open just for the race. It was a much livlier dynamic than during a typical weekday or even weekend.

turns.question: How did you prepare? Tell me about the training or practice, how long you prepared, and any totals you remember. Estimates are fine.
turns.answer: I looked up a couch to 5k program on reddit and pretty much did it. I am an amateur so didn't track too much.

turns.question: Beyond those numbers, what was the preparation actually like for you? Was there a particular part of the routine you want to remember?
turns.answer: It was intimidating at first, but then a friend told me that it was OK just to stop and go stop and go -- or alternatite between running and walking. I could build up at my own pace and that was OK

turns.question: What was the lead-up like in the week before, the day before, or the morning of? What stands out about how you felt?
turns.answer: Overall just lots of excitement. This seemed like an inclusionary thing and something for berginners. By the time the actual event happened, I was less conerned about beign able to to it and more just looking forward to it. I made a playlist for some songs going just over my estimated time, so that I could do some pre-game, would have song sngs to skip, and if I needed to walk it out or off I coulod do that tooo .

turns.question: Take me through the experience. Which highlights or lowlights stand out, how did they unfold, and how did you feel? They do not need to have a bigger meaning.
turns.answer: I had no idea that many people would be out there running. The biggest highlight for me was that about a mile in, my friends and cowroekrs were there to cheer me on. This gave mea second wind and I had no idea they would be there to do that.

turns.question: You mentioned people being part of the experience. Can you describe one exchange or moment with them and how it felt to you?
How did it end, and how did that compare with what you had hoped for?
turns.answer: It ended with a completion and a trophy and celebrations with out group acros the board. Pretty much everything I could have hoped for and more.

turns.question: What happened immediately afterward or later on? Was there anything about that time you want to include?
turns.answer: Afterwaresd, i was invited to cheer for the people who cheered me on the next day. That was really special to me.

turns.question: Looking back now, what would you most want this story to keep? Is there anything you are still making sense of?
turns.answer: See my answers and help me to draw any singiths
